news.title: India office occupancy may touch 89.5% by March 2028: Report
news.para: India's office market is projected to see occupancy levels rise to 89-89.5% by March 2028. Notably, net office absorption is expected to reach around 62-64 million square feet annually during this period. Demand from Global Capability Centres will contribute 45-50% of this absorption, reflecting a shift towards higher-value functions. Vacancy rates are anticipated to decline in five major markets, enhancing overall performance.

news.title: Residents in Kochi plan protest over water woes
news.para: Residents of Kochi are grappling with severe drinking water shortages, sparking protests in multiple neighborhoods. The challenges arise from a combination of leaks, aging pipelines, and insufficient infrastructure. Areas like Poonithura, Kumbalam, and Fort Kochi are particularly hard-hit. Local councillors have raised concerns, demanding that the Kerala Water Authority take urgent action. Plans for a new water treatment plant could potentially alleviate the ongoing crisis.

news.title: Ten spots in Gurugram to get temporary C&D waste storage facilities: Haryana CM
news.para: Gurgaon is embarking on a significant initiative by establishing ten temporary storage sites dedicated to managing construction and demolition waste effectively. Each planned site spans one hectare and will be fortified to prevent any debris spillage. Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini underscored the urgency for a systematic approach to waste management during a recent meeting.

news.title: SC disposes of building violation pleas; hoteliers in Mussoorie hope for relief
news.para: Recently, over 200 hotels and homestays in Mussoorie were served notices from the Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority. Following the Supreme Court's decision on unlawful constructions and the misuse of residential zones, those affected can now seek assistance from local authorities. This brings a mixture of hope and concern for hoteliers as regulatory challenges persist, while municipal officials face criticism for inadequate enforcement of existing building rules.

news.title: WSB Real Estate Partners exits six housing investments with 19-21% average IRR
news.para: WSB Real Estate Partners has exited six residential investments across major Indian markets including Bengaluru, the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, and the National Capital Region. With an impressive average internal rate of return ranging from 19% to 21%, these exits yielded returns at 1.4 times the initial investment. Notably, these transactions were completed ahead of the planned schedules set for April to November 2026.

news.title: Property dues hit ₹4,740 crore, MCG to issue notices to 1,000 tax defaulters in Gurugram
news.para: MCG plans to recover Rs 4,740 crore in property tax from its biggest 1,000 defaulters. Notices will soon be sent out as part of an extensive recovery campaign, leading to property sealings for those who remain unpaid. MCG is also focusing on improving citizen engagement, ensuring respectful service and prompt attention to issues, while reinforcing the need for strict actions against negligent staff.

news.title: DLF starts to remove diesel generator sets from green spaces in Gurugram
news.para: DLF City management has begun removing unauthorized diesel generator sets from various spots in DLF-1, responding to a compliance notice from the department of town and country planning. Tensions arose as residents challenged the DLF staff's authority during the process. With the National Green Tribunal highlighting generator placement regulations, future hearings are planned to ensure adherence to these guidelines.

news.title: Odisha proposes allowing more commercial use in residential areas
news.para: The Odisha government is set to revise urban planning laws, aiming to boost commercial ventures within residential areas. This proposed shift will affect development zones like Bhubaneswar and Cuttack. New guidelines will allow restricted construction on lands earmarked for future roadways. These changes aim to harmonize the interests of landowners with the needs of local residents. Feedback from stakeholders is encouraged prior to the adoption of the finalized regulations.

news.title: HSVP plans 388 affordable residential plots in new sector 27 in Panchkula
news.para: HSVP is embarking on an ambitious project to develop Sector 27 in Panchkula, covering over 95.1 acres. This initiative aims to provide affordable residential land tailored for the middle class. With infrastructure like sewerage and water supply already underway, road construction is also on the agenda. The diverse range of plot sizes will cater to new homeowners, with land expected to be available by 2027.

news.title: Maharashtra to roll out vertical property records in phases for individual flat owners from next year
news.para: Maharashtra plans to introduce vertical property records for individual flat owners, which will enhance land ownership documentation. The phased rollout will begin in smaller districts with a pilot project expected in early January. The new system aims to accurately reflect individual ownership rights in multi-storey buildings and their common facilities. Draft rules are currently prepared, inviting public feedback before final approval is granted.

news.title: Ikea India revenue rises 14% to ₹2,100 crore in FY26; revises profitability target to FY29
news.para: Ikea India has reported an impressive 14 percent growth in revenue for FY26, totaling Rs 2,100 crore. This surge is attributed to the performance of existing stores and new customer engagement points. Aiming for profitability by FY29, the company plans to expand its footprint to about 30-32 stores by 2030, emphasizing smaller formats.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh CM emphasises need to expand jurisdiction of LDA to cover entire Lucknow district
news.para: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has directed officials to expand the Lucknow Development Authority's jurisdiction to cover the entire district. He also emphasized the need for a new development authority in Barabanki to manage urban growth effectively. Additionally, the chief minister urged for expedited construction plans of an international cricket stadium in Ghaziabad. Officials were instructed to finalize the regional plan for the State Capital Region by November 30.

news.title: Bengaluru metro's blue line phase 2A trials begin from KR Puram; to open to public by mid-2027
news.para: Bengaluru's Blue Line Metro is gearing up with trial runs recently initiated on the Phase 2A segment. Set to kick off public operations by mid-2027, this crucial transport link will alleviate traffic on the Outer Ring Road, aiding millions of commuters and fostering economic growth. Ensuring timely completion, construction and safety certifications are on track, while the government actively navigates discussions on further Metro expansions and funding hurdles.

news.title: Chandak Group raises ₹200 crore investment for Chembur housing project
news.para: Chandak Group has secured an investment of ₹200 crore from Mori Trust for its Chembur project. This marks the first investment by Mori Trust in the Indian real estate market. The project, called Chandak Highscape City, is being developed on 23.5 acres of land. It will include residential towers, open spaces, and various common amenities. Chandak Group has previously secured another investment from a Japanese investor.

news.title: Hyderabad metro phase-II not under my purview, not aware of ₹13,600 crore IRFC loan: Railway minister
news.para: Telangana government is awaiting a Rs 13,600 crore loan from Indian Railway Finance Corporation for Metro Phase I. Union railways minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has stated he is not aware of this loan issue. The state plans to explore alternative financial institutions due to delays from the IRFC. The Centre is yet to respond to requests for financial assistance for Metro Phase II.

news.title: Delhi court rejects bail to PG operator, says he compromised building safety despite legal knowledge
news.para: A Delhi court has denied bail to Shubham Tyagi, implicating him in a tragic building collapse that claimed seven lives. Under scrutiny for prioritizing profits over safety, Tyagi, who operated a boys' guesthouse, ignored warnings from students about the illegal construction practices. His defense insisted on his limited oversight of the site, yet the court maintained accountability for his actions.

news.title: Mohali: Eco City-4 landowners to get a hearing on December 16
news.para: On December 16, a crucial public hearing will take place at the village gurdwara in Kansal, allowing landowners to voice objections about the proposed acquisition of approximately 183 acres for the Eco City-4 initiative. This project is a key component of the Greater Mohali Area Development Authority's overarching plans for New Chandigarh.

news.title: Civic bodies selective on illegal constructions: SC
news.para: The Supreme Court underscored the pervasive challenge of unauthorized constructions across Indian cities. It took aim at municipal bodies for their selective application of building regulations and how this practice detracts from the rule of law. The court noted that many violations occur with local government complicity, undermining inspection efforts.

news.title: RBI governor asks housing finance companies to strengthen cyber defences, ensure board-level oversight
news.para: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra has called for bolstered cybersecurity measures in non-banking financial companies and housing finance firms. He stressed the need for a thorough, risk-oriented strategy in tackling cyber threats, urging that management and board oversight be heightened. This call comes amid rising cyberattacks on financial institutions.

news.title: TIDCO to revive housing projects as bankers unlock ₹1,500 crore in loans for beneficiaries in Andhra Pradesh
news.para: Banks have resolved to provide ₹1,500 crore in loans to TIDCO housing beneficiaries in Andhra Pradesh. This development will facilitate the handover of 20,000 houses by December, while enabling further progress on 54,000 additional units. The government aims to expedite the registration of completed houses and also provide essential amenities in these housing complexes.
